svg.title: A small naming convention
svg.desc: Choose a few fields in a fixed order, define what each field means, and write down one example. Use a stable identifier for the subject, an unambiguous date when useful, and a fixed width for sequence numbers. Keep revisions separate from approval status. Test the convention on a small set before using it more widely.
